kills.text: Line drops 15 or more points within 14 days of a close at 75 or higher: sell everything but the moonbag.
BTC closes 7 days in a row below its 200-day average with the Line at 60 or higher: cut the meme book in half.
DOGE closes 7 days in a row below its 50-day average while the Season Flag is on: the flag goes off.
